gloss_en: God's governance (hanhagah) of the world during the six weekdays — the Holy One, blessed be He's mode of conducting creation on the ordinary (non-Sabbath) days, identified in Likutey Moharan 11 with the Lower Unification (yichuda tata'ah) and with the enclothement of Kabbalah within Halakhah
canonical_he: הנהגת הקדוש ברוך הוא בששת ימי החל
